claims.statement: Pinned table guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES; table shows issues/PRs/drafts and native/custom metadata. Showing/hiding or reordering columns changes presentation, not repository access or field deletion.

Grouping cannot use title, labels, reviewers or linked PRs in pinned reusable. Slicing cannot use title/reviewers/linked PRs; label omission from slice prohibition must not be conflated with group limitations.
Dragging item between groups applies destination group value; adding item within group populates that value. Grouped row operations may mutate data even when other view changes are unsaved.
Slicing selects a field value and narrows current view while respecting its existing filter. Resulting count is filtered view denominator, not complete project inventory or access assurance.

Fields and rows can be reordered by dragging headers or row numbers. Source does not specify interactions with sort/group/filter, persistence or cross-user concurrency; use separately reviewed view-save rules without certifying all row drag behavior.

Sort supports primary and secondary fields and direction changes; clicking sorted field removal wording overlaps direction procedure. Exact cycle semantics remain unverified, not invented deterministic comparator behavior.

Field sums/counts display by board column or grouped table/roadmap header. Estimated hours sum is planning data, not measured effort or acceptance; hidden/redacted/filtered item coverage and numeric units must remain explicit.

Six customization fragments and nested open-view-menu plus table-layout reusable reviewed. Linked detailed guides are separate evidence; no views/items modified, accepted policy, rights clearance or native verification.
